_: THE list of Jon's programs. build.py writes the Apps menu (cool-tools/apps/), the Cool tools front page and the cloud's hidden .relay-apps\apps.json (the file manager and the files service read it there) from this file. A new program = one entry here, its drawing in icons/make_icons.py, then python build.py. 'path' is the program's folder on the site; 'about' is the front page's line, 'short' the Apps menu's; 'folder' its folder in a person's home (only when it saves); 'extensions' its own file kinds (the first is the one it saves); 'opens' other kinds it can open; 'listed': false keeps an entry out of the menu, the front page and Open with (a test entry that is in the list only so the files service knows its id, or a program that is not published yet). A group shows only while it has a listed program.

programs.name: Book reader
programs.short: Reads books aloud with AI voices
programs.about: Reads books and documents aloud with AI voices that run in your browser. Open from the Cloud File Manager or this device; several books, each with its own place.

programs.name: Cloud File Manager
programs.short: Your files and the Shared Folder
programs.about: Your files and the Shared Folder, from anywhere: open, download, upload, move, rename and delete (into a trash).

programs.name: Settings
programs.short: Your account, and the PC's settings
programs.about: Your name, picture and password. For admins: the people, programs, files and activity of the PC.

programs.name: Text editor
programs.short: Write and change plain text files
programs.about: Opens, changes and saves any plain text file in the Cloud File Manager or on this device: notes, lists, subtitles, settings files. Search and replace across the whole file.

programs.name: Plan Cutter
programs.short: Lay and cut sheets in a crooked room
programs.about: Draw a crooked room, lay sheet material on a ceiling or wall, cut it along the walls and get the numbers to mark on the real board.

programs.name: Screen Peek (test)
programs.short: A live look at Jon's desktop
programs.about: Shows a live screenshot of Jon's desktop, single or continuous, for those allowed to use it. Works only while sharing is on at the PC.

programs.name: Simple Bench
programs.about: A 10-second device test: processor and graphics card scores, and which voice and settings the Book reader would suggest on this device.

programs.name: Browser app cache manager
programs.short: See and delete what these tools stored
programs.about: See and delete what these tools have stored in your browser: books, settings, downloaded voice files.

programs.name: Thaw
programs.short: Bring dead planets back to life
programs.about: A game with a real climate model. Wake a planet that is frozen solid or far too hot, then switch your machines off and see whether it stays alive on its own.

programs.name: HYPERWAVE Studio
programs.about: Sound-reactive visuals: shapes, fractals and 4D forms that react to sound. Experimental and no longer worked on.

programs.name: Cloud kit demo
programs.short: A tiny notepad that tries the cloud kit
programs.about: A tiny notepad that tries the cloud kit (file-manager\kit). For testing only.

programs.name: Starter
programs.short: The template a new program starts from
programs.about: The template a new program starts from: the Apps button, the cloud indicator, New, Open and Save (app-kit\starter).
